subject: science
title: The digestive system
canDo: I can name the organs of the digestive system and describe what each one does.

subject: science
title: How plants make food
canDo: I can explain how green plants use light, water and carbon dioxide to make food and oxygen.

subject: science
title: Classification and keys
titleId: Klasifikasi makhluk hidup dan kunci determinasi
canDo: I can use and make a branching key to identify living things.

subject: science
title: Food webs and human impact
titleId: Jaring-jaring makanan dan dampak kegiatan manusia
canDo: I can read a food web and predict what happens when a population or a habitat changes.

subject: science
title: Reversible and irreversible changes
titleId: Perubahan yang dapat balik dan tidak dapat balik
canDo: I can sort changes into reversible and irreversible and spot when a new material forms.

subject: science
title: Properties of metals and materials
canDo: I can describe the properties of metals and choose a material for a job by its properties.

subject: science
title: Circuit symbols and changing circuits
canDo: I can draw circuits with symbols and predict how changing cells or bulbs changes the brightness.

subject: science
title: Balanced and unbalanced forces
titleId: Gaya seimbang dan gaya tidak seimbang
canDo: I can use force arrows to tell if forces are balanced and predict how an object will move.

subject: science
title: Levers, pulleys and gears
titleId: Pesawat sederhana: tuas, katrol, dan roda gigi
canDo: I can explain how levers, pulleys, gears and ramps make a job easier.

subject: science
title: Reflection, refraction and seeing
titleId: Pemantulan, pembiasan, dan cara mata melihat
canDo: I can explain how we see things and describe how light reflects and refracts.

subject: science
title: The Solar System, Moon and seasons
titleId: Tata Surya, fase Bulan, dan musim
canDo: I can describe the Solar System, explain the phases of the Moon and say why seasons happen.

subject: science
title: Earth's structure, volcanoes and earthquakes
titleId: Struktur Bumi, gunung api, dan gempa bumi
canDo: I can describe the layers of the Earth and explain how moving plates cause earthquakes and volcanoes.

subject: science
title: Line graphs and evidence
canDo: I can read and draw line graphs, spot patterns and decide if evidence supports a conclusion.
